candidates.snippet: Russian media say over 10 police vans arrived at Gorka park in Moscow's Kitay-gorod, where police are detaining young people in the park and near local bars. Detainees say there's barely any air in the vans. Police haven't explained the reason. https://t.co/qzyb9FbNsn

Four units are confirmed hit at the Saratov refinery. They're the pentane-hexane isomerization unit, ELOU-AVT-6, the visbreaking unit and the L-24-6 hydrotreating unit. The catalytic reforming unit may have been hit too, but there's not enough footage to confirm it. https://t.co/
